auth_env_var_specs.name: SLACK_USER_TOKEN
auth_env_var_specs.description: Slack user token (xoxp-...) for the AtomChat workspace. Falls back to ~/.claude/slack-user-token.env if env var unset.

auth_env_var_specs.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
auth_env_var_specs.description: Optional bot token (xoxb-...) for post-only flows. Set this OR SLACK_USER_TOKEN.

novel_features.name: Customer Intel Deep
novel_features.description: A one-screen, time-ordered timeline for a customer joining Slack mentions, the Attio deal stage at that moment, open Asana tasks, and Fathom call action items — every line cited with a permalink.

novel_features.name: DM Engagement
novel_features.description: One volume row per direct report: DM count with you, Asana tasks created and completed, and Fathom calls attended over a time window.

novel_features.name: Action Follow-through
novel_features.description: For each Fathom call action item assigned to a CSM, whether that person mentioned the company in Slack within the window — with the matching permalink when they did.

novel_features.name: Goal Channel Pulse
novel_features.description: Per active Asana Rock in the current quarter, the mapped Slack channel's 7-day message count, unique participants, total reactions, and a stalled flag when discussion is zero.

novel_features.name: Reactions Summarize
novel_features.description: Aggregates emoji reactions across every message in a channel over a window: top messages by reaction count, emoji distribution, and a fixed emoji-class bucket count.

novel_features.name: Unreads Priority
novel_features.description: An inventory of unread DMs, at-mentions, and involved threads, bucketed by priority — DM over partner channel over internal channel over broadcast — with per-bucket counts.

novel_features.name: Usergroups Render
novel_features.description: Lists usergroups with handle and members, and renders subteam mentions in all output as readable @handles instead of raw <!subteam^S...> IDs.

novel_features.name: Agent Audit
novel_features.description: Shows which agents and cron jobs read which Slack DMs and channels over a window, sourced from the CLI's own append-only DM-read audit log.
